messages:
nora: Heads-up: support ticket 8942 attached a debug bundle with full traces + user emails. We need to scrub and delete from S3 and the redis snapshot. Quick q: do I need legal approval to run a one-off scrub, or can eng-security approve? Also what deletion audit fields do I need to capture? /cc @elaine @sean

elaine: Thanks. If this is customer data that may contain PHI, we need legal. Eng-sec can do non-sensitive sandboxes. Which customer is it and any data residency / BAA flags?

nora: It's Brightline Health — they have a BAA, US-only. Support note says PHI might be present (masking missed). My plan: run a dry-run redaction in staging S3 + local scrub script against the support bundle, attach logs, and don't touch prod until we have signoff.

sean: If PHI is possible, legal signoff required. Also capture these steps in a compliance ticket. Suggested checklist:
1) Snapshot current objects: `aws s3 sync s3://redwood-support/debug/8942 ./archive/8942 --exact-timestamps`
2) Dry-run scrub: ```/opt/tools/scrub_debug --bucket s3://redwood-support/debug --pattern "*8942*" --dry-run --out dryrun-8942.log```
3) Attach dry-run logs to ticket, request legal review.
4) On approval, run with `--execute`, then run `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-support/debug/8942 --recursive` and add deletion markers to retention log.
I'll open the INF ticket and add these steps.

elaine: For redis/kv snapshot: prefer to delete keys by namespace and avoid flushing instances. Example commands for QA cache:
`redis-cli -h cache-qa KEYS "support:8942:*" | xargs -L1 redis-cli -h cache-qa DEL`
After deletion rotate the namespace TTL or move to new prefix so accidental rehits are avoided. Tag ticket `redaction-request` so infra sees it.

nora: I'll open the compliance ticket INF-2026 and attach the dry-run. Who signs off after legal? @audit-bot or eng-sec lead?

audit-bot: audit-bot: Created INF-2026 and assigned to eng-security. Approvals required: Legal, EngSec lead. Please attach scrub dry-run, list of affected buckets/keys, and the proposed retention update.

elaine: :thumbsup: I'll review the dry-run and the affected object list. If Legal confirms PHI, I can sign off and coordinate the deletion window with infra (low-traffic window preferred).

nora: Plan: running dry-run in ~30m, will attach logs to INF-2026 and ping legal. Thanks all.
